Movement

Exploration movement is measured in turns (10 minutes) and dungeon movement in rounds. Encumbered characters move more slowly; the movement rate is derived from total carried weight. Running increases speed but makes stealth impossible and can cause fatigue.

Encumbrance (cn)Movement / turnMovement / round
Up to 400120 ft12 ft
401-60090 ft9 ft
601-80060 ft6 ft
801-1,00030 ft3 ft
Over 1,000Cannot move—

Water and air travel use their own tables for ships, rowing and flying speeds; weather and currents modify travel time.
